stories.title: Official says 273 arrested in NCCIA raid on 'illegal' call centre on Karachi's Sharea Faisal
stories.brief: KARACHI: The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) on Thursday claimed to have conducted a major operation against an alleged international fraud network and arrested 273 people from a call centre located on Sharea Faisal.

stories.title: Minister says electoral reforms panel to have 2 members each from PML-N, PPP and PTI
stories.brief: The ruling PML-N, its coalition partner PPP and the opposition PTI will each get two seats on the proposed Parliamentary Committee on Electoral Reforms (PCER), Parliamentary Affairs Minister Tariq Fazal Chaudhry said on Thursday.

stories.title: NCCIA arrests 273 people, including 42 minors, in Karachi call centre raid
stories.brief: Court grants NCCIA two-day remand of nine suspects in the case Earlier today, a judicial magistrate granted the NCCIA a two-day physical remand of nine key suspects arrested during the raid.

stories.title: Tariq Fazal says PML-N, PPP and PTI to get two seats apiece on electoral reforms committee
stories.brief: Parliamentary Affairs Minister Tariq Fazal Chaudhry said on Thursday that the Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz (PML-N), the Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) and the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) would each be allotted two seats each in the Senate's Electoral Reforms Committee.

stories.title: CDF visits SSG headquarters, stresses operational readiness for tackling security threats: ISPR
stories.brief: CDF Munir made the remarks during a visit to the Special Services Group (SSG) headquarters in Tarbela, where he was briefed on “specialised training, operational preparedness and mission-oriented readiness”, according to Inter Services Public Relations (ISPR).

stories.title: CDF Munir emphasises indigenous defence capabilities, sustained training to maintain security edge
stories.brief: During the visit, CDF Munir was briefed on the SSG's specialised training regime and operational capabilities. Read: Pakistan tests indigenous Fa'az missile “He also witnessed a display of state-of-the-art specialised equipment and a demonstration showcasing SSG’s combat proficiency, agility and precision in executing special operations,” the ISPR said.

stories.title: ECP sets Feb 7 as polling date for first phase of Punjab local govt elections; KP polls delayed
stories.brief: ISLAMABAD: The Election Commission of Pakistan (ECP) on Thursday decided to hold the first phase of local government elections in Punjab on Feb 7, 2027, in view of fog and weather conditions, while polls in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa were postponed until further orders.

stories.title: ECP announces February 7 for Punjab LG polls, suspends K-P election process
stories.brief: A four-member bench headed by Chief Election Commissioner Sikandar Sultan Raja heard the case concerning local government elections in Punjab. The Punjab chief secretary informed the commission that preparations for the local government elections had been completed.

stories.title: Shares in Musk's SpaceX plunge as tech and AI stocks fall
stories.brief: The market has been reacting to possible tougher scrutiny of data centre construction and the AI industry following the US mid-terms

stories.title: UK found to be ‘dangerously’ reliant on China for critical minerals needed for defence and AI
stories.brief: Delivering net zero also at risk, say MPs as they call for centralised policy and funding for mines and diversification The UK is “dangerously” dependent on China for critical raw materials needed for the military, renewable energy infrastructure and AI, a parliamentary investigation has found.MPs on the business select committee called for an urgent centralised…

stories.title: Elon Musk’s nearly half a billion dollars in midterms spending was a flop
stories.brief: The tech billionaire set spending record as he poured $446m into campaigns for failed Republican candidatesElon Musk set a record for election spending this year after pouring nearly half a billion dollars into backing Republicans in the US midterm elections. He outdid his own 2024 spending of nearly $290m.

stories.title: Elon Musk's millions failed to deliver Republican wins in fierce midterms
stories.brief: Musk spent nearly $500m in the 2026 US midterm elections, an individual election spending record.

stories.title: UNSC adopts Pakistan-initiated statement on 'role of diplomacy during active hostilities'
stories.brief: The United Nations Security Council (UNSC) on Thursday adopted a presidential statement on the "role of diplomacy during active hostilities", an initiative spearheaded by Pakistan, the Foreign Office (FO) said.

stories.title: 11 killed, 33 injured as bus collides with truck near Punjab's Pakpattan
stories.brief: At least 11 people, including a Patrolling Police official and a Para Force personnel, were killed and 33 others injured on Thursday when a passenger bus collided with a truck on Depalpur Road, a Rescue 1122 spokesperson, Umair Iqbal, said.

stories.title: Army foils TTP infiltration attempt in Kurram, retaliates to 'unprovoked' Afghan firing: state media
stories.brief: The latest escalation followed an incident on November 1 when security forces responded to unprovoked firing from Afghan border posts near Angoor Adda in South Waziristan, forcing Afghan Taliban personnel to abandon their positions.

stories.title: Federal government announces Nov 9 public holiday for Iqbal Day
stories.brief: The Punjab government also declared November 9 a public holiday in the province to mark the 149th birth anniversary of Iqbal, the national poet of Pakistan. The Sindh government on Wednesday announced that all public and private schools across the province would remain closed on November 9 to observe the occasion.

stories.title: Russell Brand found guilty by UK court of rape and sexual assaults
stories.brief: British comedian and actor Russell Brand was found guilty in a London court on Thursday of rape and sexual assaults,and told he faces a lengthy jail sentence. He was convicted at London's Southwark Crown Court of one count of rape and three sexual assaults.

stories.title: Melania Trump calls for peace at meeting with Russia, Ukraine officials
stories.brief: US first lady hosts Russian, Ukrainian officials at the White House, urges two sides to build on recent local truce.

stories.title: Melania Trump calls for lasting Ukraine truce as she hosts Russian and Ukrainian officials
stories.brief: The US first lady was credited by all for playing a key though unspecified role in the ceasefire.

stories.title: US tech shares fall sharply as investors bet on AI slowdown after Democrats’ election triumph
stories.brief: The tech-heavy index was heading for its biggest one-day fall since Donald Trump announced his “liberation day” tariffs on US trading partners in April 2025.
